summary: The agent successfully completed an economic time-series analysis involving: (1) extracting nominal spending data from Excel files, (2) deflating using price indices, (3) applying the Hodrick-Prescott filter to extract cyclical components, and (4) computing Pearson correlation. The workflow is reusable for macroeconomic co-movement analysis. Key lessons: always verify the final answer file format (trailing newlines, decimal precision), use lambda=100 for annual HP filtering, and apply HP filter to log-transformed real values not levels. The skill captures the complete reproducible workflow with validation steps.
